title: Mirror across the divider
written_solution: Keep the divider of `9`s and the existing left-side object. Then reflect every nonzero non-divider cell across the divider and paint the mirrored copy on the right side.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (f14-full-cols grid color) (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) color)) (range (rows grid)))) (range (cols grid)))) (define (f14-full-col grid color) (let ((hits (f14-full-cols grid color))) (if (empty? hits) #f (first hits)))) (let ((div (f14-full-col g 9))) (if (not div) g (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (rows g))) (c (in-range div))) (let ((v (at g r c)) (mc (+ div (- div c)))) (if (and (not (member? v (list 0 9))) (in-bounds? r mc (rows g) (cols g))) (set-cell out r mc v) out)))))))
